title: Hawaii Surcharge Proration to the Returned Companion Fare, Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
**Rule.** On a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product, how much of a cancelled booking's Hawaii surcharge comes back follows the share of the companion fare that came back. That share is the most recent companion fare refund on the certificate divided by the most recent companion fare charge on the certificate; where the certificate carries no companion fare refund, the amount refunded is taken as zero.

| Share of the companion fare that came back | Part of the Hawaii surcharge that comes back |
|---|---|
| below 0.9 | the surcharge in that same share, rounded half up to the cent |
| 0.9 or more but below one | the surcharge less a flat surcharge handling amount of 25 USD |
| one (the whole companion fare came back) | the surcharge in full |

## Hypothetical worked cases (Hawaii surcharge charge of 100.00 USD, companion fare charge of 249.00 USD)

| Most recent companion fare refund | Share | Part of the surcharge coming back |
|---|---|---|
| 249.00 | 1 | 100.00 |
| 230.00 | about 0.924 (0.9 or more, below one) | 75.00 |
| 224.10 | exactly 0.9 | 75.00 |
| 174.30 | 0.7 | 70.00 |
| 83.00 | about 0.3333 | 33.33 |

A share exactly at 0.9 falls in the flat-handling band, not the proportional band.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
